data.validation: Whole literal seed mod10=0; both sources. Never tuning on heldout games.
data.inputs: Own hand and public information only; simulated hidden locations are supervised targets only. No D1/human/Clint/GuanZero data or teachers.

evaluation.secondary: Final029-reason vs baseline029-reason isolates belief adaptation; paired final-minus-baseline against commonold is descriptive
evaluation.accept: Both direct final-old and final-baseline97.5% seed-pair cluster intervals strictly above0 (Bonferroni familywise95% for two gates). Complete1000 pairs each required. No promotion on partial/time-selected samples.
evaluation.report: W/L/D,finishing-rank pairs,double-ups/double-downs,search timing/fallbacks separately. No merged overall win rate or whole-match/human claim.
